post.description: Server-side proxy to Autumn. The path segment names an autumn-js RPC operation; the bridge translates it to Autumn's dotted REST path, injects `customer_id = org_id` (from the host subdomain) into the body, and forwards with the server's autumn secret. Bodies and response shapes follow Autumn's public API — this route is intentionally schema-opaque.

200.description: Upstream Autumn response body — see https://docs.useautumn.com/api-reference

get.summary: 302 → tilde:// deep link from the `deep_link` query param
get.description: Generic browser-bounce used as the `success_url` / `cancel_url` for Stripe-hosted flows (Checkout, customer portal, SetupIntent) because Stripe rejects custom-scheme URLs there. The frontend builds `?deep_link=tilde://...` (encoded) and the desktop app intercepts the resulting navigation. The handler only accepts `tilde://...` URLs to prevent this route from being used as an open-redirect.

parameters.name: deep_link
parameters.description:
The `tilde://` deep link to bounce the browser to. Must start with
the `tilde://` scheme — anything else is rejected so this route
can't be turned into an open-redirect gadget.
